title: Make Code as Policy Great Again: Frontier Agents Write, Call, and Evolve Robot Tools
abstract: arXiv:2609.39018v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier models can control robots, but reasoning through every reach, grasp, and retreat makes manipulation slow and token-intensive. We revisit code as policy with a different division of labor: models build executable tools, code handles multi-phase motions, and models decide what to do next. We introduce URAI (Universal Robot-Agent Interface), which couples a programming agent that constructs robot tools with an execution agent that uses them in a feedback loop. The programming agent writes reusable and task-specific tools from task intent and refines them through execution feedback and human guidance. The execution agent selects and parameterizes these tools from current observations; each call runs a complete motion locally before returning control to the agent. translated_title: 让代码即策略再次伟大：前沿智能体编写、调用并进化机器人工具
translated_abstract: 前沿模型可以控制机器人，但通过推理每一个伸展、抓取和回撤动作会使操作变得缓慢且消耗大量token。我们以不同的分工方式重新审视“代码即策略”：模型构建可执行的工具，代码处理多阶段运动，模型决定下一步做什么。我们提出URAI（通用机器人-智能体接口），它将构建机器人工具的编程智能体与在反馈循环中使用这些工具的执行智能体相结合。编程智能体根据任务意图编写可复用和任务特定的工具，并通过执行反馈和人工指导不断完善这些工具。执行智能体根据当前观测选择并参数化这些工具；每次调用都会在本地运行完整的运动，然后再将控制权返回给智能体。与将后续决策委托给生成的程序不同，这种设计在工具执行之间保留了模型层面的决策能力。经过验证的工具修订会被持续保……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 提出URAI（通用机器人-智能体接口）框架，采用“模型编写可执行工具、代码执行多阶段运动、模型在工具调用间做决策”的分工方式，让前沿模型能够高效且低token消耗地控制机器人。
en_tdlr: We introduce URAI, a framework coupling a programming agent that writes robot tools with an execution agent that invokes them—code handles multi-phase motions while the model retains decision-making between tool calls—enabling efficient, token-lean robot manipulation by frontier models.
